about: Labels whose topics are decided by hand, not by the match rules in topics.json (issue #18). Two kinds: broad words that fit many topics, and words that mean different things on different portals. A label here is a normalized label (see topics.json normalize). An entry with label_type applies only to that kind of label (category, tag or department); without it, to every kind. An empty topics list means no topic, on purpose. Hand entries win over the match rules. Every entry says why. Method: docs/topics.md.

labels.label: infrastructure
labels.why: Broad word, on 14 portals. Most uses sit on utility, energy and telecommunications layers. Roads and bridges get Transportation from their own words.

labels.label: safety
labels.why: Broad word: public, traffic, school or food safety. On its own it is filed under Public safety, as nine portals use it.

labels.label: quality safety cost
labels.why: Health Data NY's hospital quality category. Patient safety, not public safety; 'cost' keeps Budget and finance.

labels.label: patient safety indicator
labels.why: Hospital quality measures. Patient safety, not public safety.

labels.label: green infrastructure
labels.why: Stormwater management (bioswales, rain gardens), not utilities.

labels.label: development
labels.why: Broad word: economic, land or youth development. On its own it sits on planning and zoning layers, so Land use.

labels.label: acs
labels.why: As a tag on six portals, ACS is the American Community Survey. NYC's Administration for Children's Services is a department name, not a tag, and gets Social services from its full name.

labels.label: acs
labels.why: Same as the tag: the American Community Survey.

labels.label: lot
labels.why: A tax lot in assessment rolls, a parking lot in snow-emergency data (both in Buffalo). No topic. 'tax lot' still gets Property from the match rules.

labels.label: station
labels.why: Police, fire or subway station. Most uses are transit stations; police and fire layers get Public safety from their own words.

labels.label: ticket
labels.why: A parking, traffic or court summons ticket. Both topics, since it is about enforcement on the street.

labels.label: discharge
labels.why: A water-pollution discharge (SPDES) or a hospital discharge. Hospital data carries health words of its own, so this is filed under Environment and Water.
